SELECT unpack_id, unpack_no, label_code, material_name, specification, batch_no, package_quantity, bulk_quantity, warehouse_name, status, create_user_name, create_time FROM spd_package_unpack WHERE del_flag = 0
AND unpack_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.unpackNo}, '%')
AND label_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.labelCode}, '%')
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
